projects.title: Stories with a preview scrubber

media.alt: Placeholder image for the stories preview scrubber experiment

body: Placeholder copy. A quick prototype exploring how you could skim through someone's stories with a thumbnail preview. Long press to bring up the preview panel, scroll to scrub, and tap to jump straight to a story.
Built in an afternoon to test whether a scrubber feels faster than tapping through one story at a time.

projects.title: Mini player for desktop music

media.alt: Placeholder video for the desktop mini player experiment

body: Placeholder copy. A compact always-on-top player that keeps controls within reach without taking over the screen. Hover to reveal the queue, drag to dock it to any corner.
A short exploration of how much of the full app can collapse into a single floating card.
